name: Forward deployed engineer
oneLiner: Postings up 729% in a year: the job that exists because AI projects fail for organisational reasons.
why: Enterprise AI deployments fail on process and data politics, not model quality
The role sits inside the customer, so the human relationship is the product
threats: Vendor-published and job-board counts are not official occupational statistics
Highly concentrated in a handful of AI labs and consultancies

claims.text: Job postings grew from 643 in April 2025 to 5,330 in April 2026 — a 729% increase — on hiring data compiled by Exponent.
The role exists because enterprise AI deployments often fail for organisational rather than technical reasons, and an embedded engineer clears those blockers faster than a traditional vendor model.
Roughly 70% of postings include equity, and the median base across postings is about $174,000.
